text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. During each sprint, the team completes a small part of the project, which allows for iterative development and quick feedback. Every morning, team members have short meetings called standups to discuss progress and problems. All tasks and user stories are kept in a backlog, which is a prioritised list of work. User stories describe what the customer needs, helping the team stay focused on real value. This flexible approach makes it easier to adapt to changes.
